card.desc: An arrow loosed. Creak, release, and the air after it.
card.prompt: a wooden bow string drawn and released, sharp twang and arrow whoosh, close, dry
card.negative: music, speech, reverb, impact, thud, crowd, repeating
card.note: The whoosh sells it more than the twang; keep 'arrow whoosh' in the prompt.
